meta.name: speech-to-text
meta.description: Transcribe audio to text with ElevenLabs Scribe and OpenAI GPT Transcribe via inference.sh CLI. Models: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (98%+ accuracy, diarization, word timestamps), GPT Transcribe (fast, low cost, key-term hints). Capabilities: transcription, multi-language, timestamps, speaker diarization, audio event tagging, realtime microphone transcription. Use for: meeting transcription, subtitles, podcast transcripts, voice notes. Triggers: speech to text, transcription, gpt transcribe, openai transcribe, audio to text, transcribe audio, voice to text, stt, automatic transcription, subtitles generation, transcribe meeting, audio transcription, whisper, elevenlabs stt, scribe, eleven labs transcribe

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
